name: SYMMETRY
description:
Symmetry is a survival management game set in a retro-futuristic sci-fi universe. Your main goal is to manage the crash survivors and help them withstand the desolate, extremely cold environment so that they can fix their spacecraft and escape. The non-obvious plot is accompanied by an atmospheric musical score and graphic design that sustains the harsh and mysterious ambience.

Survivors need to take care of crucial life functions, such as eating, resting, and mental health. Extreme circumstances may force crew members to develop new skills, like Botanics or power plant operations, that weren't necessary in their Earthly lives. Gathering all the parts required to repair the spaceship becomes a race against time, as extreme weather conditions and life-threatening supernatural activities become increasingly present.

Vector graphics give the game a feeling of mystery and severity of the deserted world. Using dimmed and pastel colors throughout the scenery creates a sense of remoteness from reality and builds an unreal atmosphere of the landscape.
